couplets.en: Someone drew near at the first light of dawn.
I was put to the test at dawn.
Someone drew near at the first light of dawn.

lines: Meri daastaan ko zara sa badal kar
couplets.en: They changed my story ever so slightly.
Then they told it back to me at dawn.

lines: Jo kehta tha kal shab sambhalna sambhalna
couplets.en: Last night he kept telling me to mind my step.
By dawn, he was the one who stumbled.

lines: Kati raat saari meri maikade mein
couplets.en: I spent the whole night in the tavern.
